about: Every number this video shows or says, with its source. PHCP Pros' Sep 29, 2026 article on ServiceTitan's 2026 State of AI in the Trades report re-read on Oct 29, 2026 (11% high or complete trust, 58% little or no trust, over 1,000 residential service contractors). The prompt and the drafted check-in are examples, not data.

servicetitan.title: ServiceTitan Report Finds AI Adoption Accelerating Across the Trades
servicetitan.report: The Update: 2026 State of AI in the Trades Report (ServiceTitan)
servicetitan.quote: only 11% of contractors place high or complete trust in the AI tools they use, while 58% report little or no trust
servicetitan.method: Based on a study of over 1,000 residential service contractors across the US, in HVAC, electrical, plumbing, roofing, and other sectors
servicetitan.scope: Vendor survey reported by trade press. The article says 'contractors' for the trust figures without saying all respondents or AI users only, so the video says 'contractors'. Not cleaning-specific. Descriptive, not a correlation.
servicetitan.context: Same article: active engagement with AI rose from 46% (Dec 2025) to 52% (Sep 2026); 34% cite providing off-hours support as a reason to experiment with AI; among AI users, accuracy and reliability is the leading concern at 35% (not used in the video).

prompt.source: OURS: advice, an example prompt (no AI product named)
prompt.line1: Write a short check-in on this quote, in my voice.
prompt.draft: Hi, just checking in on the quote I sent for your deep clean. Any questions I can answer?
prompt.note: lines is the count of sentences in the prompt itself, not a finding; the draft is an example
